name: rlg-mcp
description: MCP server exposing rlg (RustLogs) log files as tools for on-call / SRE agent workflows. Three tools over JSON-RPC stdio — tail_log (last N events, filtered by level/target), filter_log (predicate filtering), summarize_errors (grouped error taxonomy). Pure Rust. MIT OR Apache-2.0.
